submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Targeted hand/arm repair of an existing full-body animation cel, not a new character design. Output one independently redrawn square native 1254x1254 (at least 1024) transparent PNG.
INPUT 1 is the EDIT TARGET, existing EAST run frame01. Keep its exact face, hair, blue/gold/ivory costume, scale, head size, two-legged landing pose, fan design and full canvas layout. INPUT 2 is the original front-facing identity reference proving the fan belongs to his ANATOMICAL RIGHT HAND. INPUT 3 is the already drawn opposite-phase EAST running pose, showing the correct NEAR RIGHT SHOULDER and fan hand chain. INPUT 4 is the approved primary painted style only, ignore its UI.
Repair ONLY the arm ownership and sleeve/hand anatomy in input1, preserving its useful landing pose. EAST faces screen RIGHT, with the right flank nearest camera. The visible NEAR shoulder is anatomical RIGHT: its blue shoulder panel must connect to a bent right upper arm extending FORWARD across the body to screen right, right elbow bent, forearm forward, RIGHT fingers firmly wrap the black fan pivot beneath the open ivory water-dragon fan. The near right forearm and sleeve OCCLUDE the torso and far arm. Draw a readable continuous shoulder-elbow-wrist-grip chain. The rearward swinging EMPTY LEFT arm is the FAR arm, emerging from the FAR shoulder behind torso, only its distal sleeve and small empty fist visible toward screen LEFT behind the waist. Do not attach the empty fist to the near shoulder. Exactly TWO hands; one near-right fan hand in front and one far-left empty fist behind. No fan floating beside hand; the black rib pivot is physically gripped.
Keep frame01 phase: LEFT foot reaches forward for touchdown, RIGHT leg trails back bent with raised heel. Right fan arm forward opposing right leg; left empty arm back opposing left leg. Torso leans 8 degrees rightward. Invisible floor at 95% canvas, source root (50%,95%); preserve the source image scale/camera rather than fitting a new bounding box. No body translation, zoom, relighting or costume redesign. Original navy hair, turquoise/gold hair jewel, blue tassels, jade fixed anatomical left hip (far hip in this E view; do not relocate onto near hip). Clear boots and knees. Bright clean rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted rendering with crisp fabric/gold detail. True transparent alpha, no ground/shadow, text, labels, particles, magic effects, motion blur, grid, mirror or multi-pose sheet.
